snippet.title: Where It Happened - Official Trailer | First-person Indie Horror Game
snippet.description:
Available on Steam on October 14th, 2026!

Wishlist 'Where It Happened' on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4631470/Where_It_Happened/

You wake up to find yourself standing before an old house surrounded by a dense forest. Driven by curiosity, step inside, solve simple horror-driven puzzles, navigate surreal hallucinations, and uncover the tragic story buried within your own memories.

Where It Happened is an atmospheric first-person psychological horror game and walking simulator developed by Waycore Studio, a small team of 2. 

Key features:
• Short, intense narrative-driven terror
• Eerie, mind-bending environment shifts and hallucinations
• Exploration and clue-driven puzzles
• Mysteries surrounding a family history waiting to be unveiled

Add to your Steam Wishlist now to get notified upon release!
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4631470/Where_It_Happened/

Follow the Steam community for future updates!
Steam Community: https://steamcommunity.com/app/4631470/
